mentions.name: Boring-stack e-commerce site
mentions.description: An e-commerce site built from scratch using Phoenix LiveView, PostgreSQL, HTML, and CSS, deliberately built without the help of AI.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a boring e-commerce site from scratch, with the boring stack of Phoenix Live View, PostgreSQL, HTML and CSS. You know, the boring stuffs.

I just don't use AI building it.
